sources.summary: Data from a16z shows a Jevons paradox in the AI market: token prices keep falling, but H100 GPU rental prices hold steady or climb. Cheaper AI drives demand faster than costs drop. sources.summary: Starting October 2026, arXiv will cap submissions at two per person per month. Monthly submissions have doubled in two years, and in the cs.AI category they've grown more than sixfold. According to arXiv, a small fraction of authors are flooding the platform with low-quality papers, overwhelming its volunteer moderators. The article ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 從 2026 年 10 月開始，arXiv 將限制每人每月最多提交兩篇論文。每月提交量在兩年內翻了一倍，而在 cs.AI 分類中更是成長了六倍以上。根據 arXiv 的說法，極少數的作者正以低品質論文灌爆該平臺，讓其志工審查員應接不暇。本文「ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server」最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Odyssey is making its world model Odyssey-3 available as a public research preview. The 14-billion-parameter model generates interactive environments from text prompts in real time and can reportedly control robots, drones, and even GTA V. Odyssey claims top scores on physics benchmarks, though the methodology behind those results has limits. The article Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Odyssey 正在將其世界模型 Odyssey-3 以公開研究預覽的形式推出。這個擁有 140 億個參數的模型能從文字提示詞即時生成互動式環境，據報導還能控制機器人、無人機，甚至《GTA V》。Odyssey 宣稱其在物理基準測試中獲得最高分，儘管這些結果背後的方法論存在侷限性。這篇「Odyssey-3 是一個你可以免費試用的全新生成式世界模型」文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: Sakana AI’s LLM Peer Review System Catches 73% of Core-Claim Errors
sources.summary: Sakana AI’s TMLR paper introduces Multi-Layered Review, a 3-agent Claude-based reviewer, and a 1,164-error Contradiction Benchmark. MLR caught 73.43% of core-claim errors, versus 14.81% for the best prior system. The post Sakana AI’s LLM Peer Review System Catches 73% of Core-Claim Errors appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Sakana AI 的 TMLR 論文介紹了多層審查（Multi-Layered Review），這是一個基於 Claude 的 3 代理審查系統，以及包含 1,164 個錯誤的矛盾基準測試（Contradiction Benchmark）。MLR 揪出了 73.43% 的核心論點錯誤，而先前最佳系統的比例則為 14.81%。本文〈Sakana AI 的 LLM 同行評審系統揪出 73% 的核心論點錯誤〉最初發表於 MarkTechPost。
